pages.text: Health 320, Armor 8, Attack 25, Knockback Resistance 1.0, Speed 0.35.$(br)Melee attack:$(br)The Primordier's melee has three variants — a sweeping punch, a two-handed ground slam and a one-foot stomp — dealing 1x, 1.75x and 1.5x attack damage respectively; the latter two variants deal area damage; attacks cause 14s of Frozen and also apply Weakness (level 3, 6s) and Slowness (level 2, 6s).

Intimidation Strike$(br)When the Primordier finds a target, it roars at it; creatures near the Primordier during the roar are Frozen, after which it leaps at its target and slams the ground once, dealing area damage equal to 1.5x its attack.
Frost Absorption$(br)The Primordier is completely immune to freezing damage and absorbs it, recovering 80%% of its health.
